#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Local, single-session Codex transcript + macOS filesystem audit collector."""
import argparse
import ctypes as C
import datetime as dt
import difflib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import signal
import sqlite3
import stat
import threading
import time


def now():
    return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def dump(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))


def atomic_json(path, value):
    temp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temp.write_text(dump(value) + "\n")
    temp.replace(path)


class FileEvents:
    """FSEvents runs on its own CFRunLoop; callbacks only enqueue events."""
    def __init__(self, roots, since, pending):
        self.roots, self.since, self.pending = roots, since, pending
        self.ready = threading.Event()
        self.error = None
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.run, daemon=True)

    def start(self):
        self.thread.start()
        if not self.ready.wait(10) or self.error:
            raise RuntimeError(self.error or "FSEvents startup timeout")

    def run(self):
        try:
            cf = C.CDLL('/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation')
            fs = C.CDLL('/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/CoreServices')
            ptr = C.c_void_p
            cf.CFStringCreateWithCString.argtypes = [ptr, C.c_char_p, C.c_uint32]
            cf.CFStringCreateWithCString.restype = ptr
            cf.CFArrayCreate.argtypes = [ptr, C.POINTER(ptr), C.c_long, ptr]
            cf.CFArrayCreate.restype = ptr
            cf.CFRunLoopGetCurrent.restype = ptr
            callback_type = C.CFUNCTYPE(None, ptr, ptr, C.c_size_t, ptr,
                                       C.POINTER(C.c_uint32), C.POINTER(C.c_uint64))

            def callback(stream, info, count, paths, flags, ids):
                names = C.cast(paths, C.POINTER(C.c_char_p))
                for i in range(count):
                    self.pending.put((os.fsdecode(names[i]), int(flags[i]), int(ids[i])))

            self.callback = callback_type(callback)
            strings = [cf.CFStringCreateWithCString(None, os.fsencode(p), 0x08000100)
                       for p in self.roots]
            array = cf.CFArrayCreate(None, (ptr * len(strings))(*strings), len(strings), None)
            fs.FSEventStreamCreate.argtypes = [ptr, callback_type, ptr, ptr,
                                              C.c_uint64, C.c_double, C.c_uint32]
            fs.FSEventStreamCreate.restype = ptr
            fs.FSEventStreamScheduleWithRunLoop.argtypes = [ptr, ptr, ptr]
            fs.FSEventStreamStart.argtypes = [ptr]
            fs.FSEventStreamStart.restype = C.c_bool
            self.stream = fs.FSEventStreamCreate(None, self.callback, None, array,
                                                 self.since, 0.05, 0x10 | 0x02 | 0x04)
            if not self.stream:
                raise RuntimeError("FSEventStreamCreate failed")
            mode = ptr.in_dll(cf, 'kCFRunLoopDefaultMode')
            fs.FSEventStreamScheduleWithRunLoop(self.stream, cf.CFRunLoopGetCurrent(), mode)
            if not fs.FSEventStreamStart(self.stream):
                raise RuntimeError("FSEventStreamStart failed")
            self.ready.set()
            cf.CFRunLoopRun()
        except BaseException as exc:
            self.error = repr(exc)
            self.ready.set()


class Collector:
    categories = ('raw-session', 'prompts', 'responses', 'commands', 'tools', 'files', 'collector')

    def __init__(self, config_path):
        os.umask(0o077)
        self.config_path = Path(config_path).resolve()
        self.cfg = json.loads(self.config_path.read_text())
        self.base = self.config_path.parent
        self.out = Path(self.cfg['output_dir'])
        self.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
        self.blobs = self.out / 'snapshots'
        self.blobs.mkdir(exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
        self.lock = (self.base / 'collector.lock').open('a')
        fcntl.flock(self.lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        self.db = sqlite3.connect(self.out / 'audit.sqlite3')
        self.db.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')
        self.db.executescript('''
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
              id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, category TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL);
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (path TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data TEXT NOT NULL);
        ''')
        self.handles = {}
        # SQLite is authoritative. Rebuild exports on restart to remove crash duplicates.
        for category in self.categories:
            handle = (self.out / (category + '.jsonl')).open('w')
            self.handles[category] = handle
            for (value,) in self.db.execute('SELECT data FROM events WHERE category=? ORDER BY id', (category,)):
                handle.write(value + '\n')
            handle.flush()
        self.export_cursor = self.db.execute('SELECT coalesce(max(id),0) FROM events').fetchone()[0]
        self.pending = queue.Queue()
        self.stopping = False
        self.source = Path(self.cfg['source_transcript'])
        self.roots = [Path(p).resolve() for p in self.cfg['watch_roots']]
        if any(self.out.is_relative_to(p) for p in self.roots):
            raise ValueError('Log output must be outside watch_roots to avoid recursive logging')
        self.started = now()
        self.last_error = None

    def get(self, key, default=None):
        row = self.db.execute('SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key=?', (key,)).fetchone()
        return json.loads(row[0]) if row else default

    def set(self, key, value):
        self.db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta VALUES (?,?)', (key, dump(value)))

    def emit(self, category, value):
        if category != 'raw-session':
            value = {'timestamp': now(), 'session_id': self.cfg['session_id'], **value}
        self.db.execute('INSERT INTO events(category,data) VALUES (?,?)', (category, dump(value)))

    def export(self):
        for ident, category, value in self.db.execute(
                'SELECT id,category,data FROM events WHERE id>? ORDER BY id', (self.export_cursor,)):
            self.handles[category].write(value + '\n')
            self.export_cursor = ident
        for handle in self.handles.values():
            handle.flush()

    def normalize(self, row):
        p = row.get('payload', {})
        timestamp = row.get('timestamp', now())
        if row.get('type') == 'event_msg' and p.get('type') == 'item_completed':
            item = p.get('item', {})
            kind = item.get('type')
            base = {'timestamp': timestamp, 'turn_id': p.get('turn_id'),
                    'source': 'codex_item_completed', 'item': item}
            if kind in ('UserMessage', 'AgentMessage'):
                content = item.get('content', [])
                text = '\n'.join(x.get('text', '') for x in content if isinstance(x, dict))
                self.emit('prompts' if kind == 'UserMessage' else 'responses',
                          {**base, 'text': text, 'phase': item.get('phase')})
            elif kind == 'CommandExecution':
                self.emit('commands', {**base, 'command': item.get('command'),
                    'cwd': item.get('cwd'), 'exit_code': item.get('exit_code'),
                    'status': item.get('status'), 'output': item.get('aggregated_output'),
                    'started_at_ms': p.get('started_at_ms'), 'completed_at_ms': p.get('completed_at_ms')})
            elif kind == 'FileChange':
                self.emit('files', {**base, 'actor': 'codex', 'status': item.get('status')})
            elif kind not in ('Reasoning',):
                self.emit('tools', base)
        elif row.get('type') == 'response_item' and p.get('type') in (
                'function_call', 'custom_tool_call', 'function_call_output', 'custom_tool_call_output'):
            self.emit('tools', {'timestamp': timestamp, 'source': 'codex_response_item', 'item': p})

    def read_transcript(self):
        if not self.source.exists():
            archived = Path.home() / '.codex' / 'archived_sessions' / self.source.name
            if archived.exists():
                self.source = archived
            else:
                raise FileNotFoundError(str(self.source))
        offset = self.get('source_offset', 0)
        size = self.source.stat().st_size
        if size < offset:
            raise RuntimeError('Transcript shrank; stop and review before replaying')
        with self.source.open('rb') as source:
            source.seek(offset)
            # Bound each batch so a large output cannot starve filesystem event handling.
            for _ in range(2000):
                line = source.readline()
                if not line or not line.endswith(b'\n'):
                    break
                row = json.loads(line)
                self.emit('raw-session', row)
                self.normalize(row)
                self.set('source_offset', source.tell())

    def snapshot(self, path):
        try:
            s = path.lstat()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return None
        result = {'size': s.st_size, 'mode': stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode),
                  'mtime_ns': s.st_mtime_ns, 'inode': s.st_ino}
        if stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode):
            result.update(kind='symlink', target=os.readlink(path))
        elif stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode):
            result['kind'] = 'directory'
        elif stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode):
            result['kind'] = 'file'
            if s.st_size <= self.cfg['snapshot_max_bytes']:
                # Do not follow a symlink swapped into place between lstat/open.
                fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
                with os.fdopen(fd, 'rb') as stream:
                    if not stat.S_ISREG(os.fstat(stream.fileno()).st_mode):
                        result['snapshot_skipped'] = 'type_changed'
                        return result
                    data = stream.read(self.cfg['snapshot_max_bytes'] + 1)
                if len(data) <= self.cfg['snapshot_max_bytes']:
                    digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
                    blob = self.blobs / digest
                    if not blob.exists():
                        blob.write_bytes(data)
                    result.update(sha256=digest, snapshot=str(blob))
                else:
                    result['snapshot_skipped'] = 'size_limit'
            else:
                result['snapshot_skipped'] = 'size_limit'
        else:
            result['kind'] = 'special'
        return result

    def file_before(self, path):
        row = self.db.execute('SELECT data FROM files WHERE path=?', (str(path),)).fetchone()
        return json.loads(row[0]) if row else None

    def observe(self, path, flags=0, event_id=None, baseline=False):
        path = Path(os.path.abspath(path))
        if not any(path == root or path.is_relative_to(root) for root in self.roots):
            return
        before = self.file_before(path)
        after = self.snapshot(path)
        actions = [name for flag, name in [(0x100,'created'), (0x200,'deleted'),
                   (0x800,'renamed'), (0x1000,'modified'), (0x400,'metadata_changed'),
                   (0x4000,'owner_changed'), (0x8000,'xattr_changed')] if flags & flag]
        observed = ('created' if before is None and after is not None else
                    'deleted' if before is not None and after is None else
                    'modified' if before != after else 'event_only')
        if baseline or flags or before != after:
            value = {'source': 'filesystem_baseline' if baseline else 'macos_fsevents',
                     'actor': 'unknown', 'path': str(path), 'event_id': event_id,
                     'flags': flags, 'actions': actions, 'observed_change': observed,
                     'before': before, 'after': after}
            if not baseline and before != after:
                try:
                    old = Path(before['snapshot']).read_bytes() if before and 'snapshot' in before else b''
                    new = Path(after['snapshot']).read_bytes() if after and 'snapshot' in after else b''
                    complete = all(x is None or 'snapshot' in x for x in (before, after))
                    if complete and b'\x00' not in old + new:
                        value['diff'] = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(
                            old.decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True),
                            new.decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True),
                            fromfile=str(path) + ' (before)', tofile=str(path) + ' (after)'))
                except UnicodeError:
                    pass
            self.emit('files', value)
        if after is None:
            self.db.execute('DELETE FROM files WHERE path=?', (str(path),))
        else:
            self.db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO files VALUES (?,?)', (str(path), dump(after)))

    def reconcile(self, baseline=False):
        seen = set()
        for root in self.roots:
            for parent, directories, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False,
                    onerror=lambda e: self.emit('collector', {'event':'scan_error', 'error':str(e)})):
                for name in directories + files:
                    path = Path(parent) / name
                    seen.add(str(path))
                    self.observe(path, baseline=baseline)
        for (path,) in self.db.execute('SELECT path FROM files').fetchall():
            if path not in seen and Path(path) not in self.roots:
                self.observe(path)

    def heartbeat(self, status='running'):
        value = {'status': status, 'pid': os.getpid(), 'session_id': self.cfg['session_id'],
                 'started_at': self.started, 'updated_at': now(),
                 'source_transcript': str(self.source), 'source_offset': self.get('source_offset', 0),
                 'source_bytes': self.source.stat().st_size if self.source.exists() else None,
                 'watch_roots': [str(p) for p in self.roots],
                 'filesystem_watcher_alive': self.watcher.thread.is_alive(),
                 'last_error': self.last_error,
                 'counts': dict(self.db.execute('SELECT category,count(*) FROM events GROUP BY category'))}
        atomic_json(self.base / 'status.json', value)

    def run(self):
        self.watcher = FileEvents([str(p) for p in self.roots],
                                self.get('fsevent_id', 0xffffffffffffffff), self.pending)
        self.watcher.start()
        with self.db:
            self.reconcile(baseline=not self.get('baseline_complete', False))
            self.set('baseline_complete', True)
            self.emit('collector', {'event': 'started', 'pid': os.getpid(), 'watch_roots': self.cfg['watch_roots']})
        for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT):
            signal.signal(sig, lambda *_: setattr(self, 'stopping', True))
        last_heartbeat = 0
        while not self.stopping:
            if not self.watcher.thread.is_alive():
                raise RuntimeError(self.watcher.error or 'FSEvents thread stopped')
            try:
                with self.db:
                    self.read_transcript()
                self.last_error = None
            except Exception as exc:
                self.last_error = repr(exc)
                with self.db:
                    self.emit('collector', {'event': 'transcript_error', 'error': self.last_error})
            with self.db:
                for _ in range(10000):
                    try:
                        path, flags, event_id = self.pending.get_nowait()
                    except queue.Empty:
                        break
                    try:
                        self.observe(path, flags, event_id)
                        if flags & (0x01 | 0x02 | 0x04 | 0x20):
                            self.emit('collector', {'event':'fsevents_rescan', 'path':path, 'flags':flags})
                            self.reconcile()
                        self.set('fsevent_id', event_id)
                    except OSError as exc:
                        self.emit('collector', {'event':'file_read_error', 'path':path, 'error':str(exc)})
            self.export()
            if time.monotonic() - last_heartbeat >= self.cfg['heartbeat_seconds']:
                self.heartbeat('degraded' if self.last_error else 'running')
                last_heartbeat = time.monotonic()
            time.sleep(self.cfg['poll_seconds'])
        with self.db:
            self.read_transcript()
            self.emit('collector', {'event':'stopped'})
        self.export()
        self.heartbeat('stopped')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--config', default=str(Path(__file__).with_name('config.json')))
    parser.add_argument('--status', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config_path = Path(args.config).resolve()
    if args.status:
        status = json.loads(config_path.with_name('status.json').read_text())
        try:
            os.kill(status['pid'], 0)
            status['process_alive'] = True
        except ProcessLookupError:
            status['process_alive'] = False
        age = (dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) - dt.datetime.fromisoformat(status['updated_at'])).total_seconds()
        status['heartbeat_age_seconds'] = round(age, 1)
        print(json.dumps(status, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return 0 if status['process_alive'] and age < 15 and status['status'] == 'running' else 1
    if not json.loads(config_path.read_text()).get('enabled', False):
        return 0
    Collector(config_path).run()
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Local, single-session Codex transcript + macOS filesystem audit collector."""
+import argparse
+import ctypes as C
+import datetime as dt
+import difflib
+import fcntl
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import queue
+import signal
+import sqlite3
+import stat
+import threading
+import time
+
+
+def now():
+    return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def dump(value):
+    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
+
+
+def atomic_json(path, value):
+    temp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
+    temp.write_text(dump(value) + "\n")
+    temp.replace(path)
+

+class FileEvents:
+    """FSEvents runs on its own CFRunLoop; callbacks only enqueue events."""
+    def __init__(self, roots, since, pending, excluded):
+        self.roots, self.since, self.pending = roots, since, pending
+        self.excluded = excluded
+        self.ready = threading.Event()
+        self.error = None
+        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.run, daemon=True)
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.thread.start()
+        if not self.ready.wait(10) or self.error:
+            raise RuntimeError(self.error or "FSEvents startup timeout")
+
+    def run(self):
+        try:
+            cf = C.CDLL('/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation')
+            fs = C.CDLL('/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/CoreServices')
+            ptr = C.c_void_p
+            cf.CFStringCreateWithCString.argtypes = [ptr, C.c_char_p, C.c_uint32]
+            cf.CFStringCreateWithCString.restype = ptr
+            cf.CFArrayCreate.argtypes = [ptr, C.POINTER(ptr), C.c_long, ptr]
+            cf.CFArrayCreate.restype = ptr
+            cf.CFRunLoopGetCurrent.restype = ptr
+            callback_type = C.CFUNCTYPE(None, ptr, ptr, C.c_size_t, ptr,
+                                       C.POINTER(C.c_uint32), C.POINTER(C.c_uint64))
+
+            def callback(stream, info, count, paths, flags, ids):
+                names = C.cast(paths, C.POINTER(C.c_char_p))
+                for i in range(count):
+                    path = os.fsdecode(names[i])
+                    if not self.excluded(path):
+                        self.pending.put((path, int(flags[i]), int(ids[i])))
+
+            self.callback = callback_type(callback)
+            strings = [cf.CFStringCreateWithCString(None, os.fsencode(p), 0x08000100)
+                       for p in self.roots]
+            array = cf.CFArrayCreate(None, (ptr * len(strings))(*strings), len(strings), None)
+            fs.FSEventStreamCreate.argtypes = [ptr, callback_type, ptr, ptr,
+                                              C.c_uint64, C.c_double, C.c_uint32]
+            fs.FSEventStreamCreate.restype = ptr
+            fs.FSEventStreamScheduleWithRunLoop.argtypes = [ptr, ptr, ptr]
+            fs.FSEventStreamStart.argtypes = [ptr]
+            fs.FSEventStreamStart.restype = C.c_bool
+            self.stream = fs.FSEventStreamCreate(None, self.callback, None, array,
+                                                 self.since, 0.05, 0x10 | 0x02 | 0x04)
+            if not self.stream:
+                raise RuntimeError("FSEventStreamCreate failed")
+            mode = ptr.in_dll(cf, 'kCFRunLoopDefaultMode')
+            fs.FSEventStreamScheduleWithRunLoop(self.stream, cf.CFRunLoopGetCurrent(), mode)
+            if not fs.FSEventStreamStart(self.stream):
+                raise RuntimeError("FSEventStreamStart failed")
+            self.ready.set()
+            cf.CFRunLoopRun()
+        except BaseException as exc:
+            self.error = repr(exc)
+            self.ready.set()
+

+class Collector:
+    categories = ('raw-session', 'prompts', 'responses', 'commands', 'tools', 'files', 'collector')
+
+    def __init__(self, config_path):
+        os.umask(0o077)
+        self.config_path = Path(config_path).resolve()
+        self.cfg = json.loads(self.config_path.read_text())
+        self.base = self.config_path.parent
+        self.out = Path(self.cfg['output_dir']).resolve()
+        self.state = Path(self.cfg.get('state_dir', self.base)).resolve()
+        self.state.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
+        self.exclusions = [Path(p).resolve() for p in self.cfg.get('exclude_paths', [])]
+        self.exclusions += [self.out, self.base / '__pycache__']
+        if self.state != self.base:
+            self.exclusions.append(self.state)
+        else:
+            self.exclusions.extend(self.base / name for name in
+                ('collector.lock', 'status.json', 'status.json.tmp', 'stdout.log', 'stderr.log'))
+        self.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
+        self.blobs = self.out / 'snapshots'
+        self.blobs.mkdir(exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
+        self.lock = (self.state / 'collector.lock').open('a')
+        fcntl.flock(self.lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
+        self.db = sqlite3.connect(self.out / 'audit.sqlite3')
+        self.db.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')
+        self.db.executescript('''
+            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
+              id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, category TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL);
+            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);
+            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (path TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data TEXT NOT NULL);
+        ''')
+        self.handles = {}
+        # SQLite is authoritative. Rebuild exports on restart to remove crash duplicates.
+        for category in self.categories:
+            handle = (self.out / (category + '.jsonl')).open('w')
+            self.handles[category] = handle
+            for (value,) in self.db.execute('SELECT data FROM events WHERE category=? ORDER BY id', (category,)):
+                handle.write(value + '\n')
+            handle.flush()
+        self.export_cursor = self.db.execute('SELECT coalesce(max(id),0) FROM events').fetchone()[0]
+        self.pending = queue.Queue()
+        self.stopping = False
+        self.source = Path(self.cfg['source_transcript'])
+        self.roots = [Path(p).resolve() for p in self.cfg['watch_roots']]
+        self.started = now()
+        self.last_error = None
+
+    def excluded(self, path):
+        path = Path(os.path.abspath(path))
+        return any(path == root or path.is_relative_to(root) for root in self.exclusions)
+
+    def get(self, key, default=None):
+        row = self.db.execute('SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key=?', (key,)).fetchone()
+        return json.loads(row[0]) if row else default
+
+    def set(self, key, value):
+        self.db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta VALUES (?,?)', (key, dump(value)))
+
+    def emit(self, category, value):
+        if category != 'raw-session':
+            value = {'timestamp': now(), 'session_id': self.cfg['session_id'], **value}
+        self.db.execute('INSERT INTO events(category,data) VALUES (?,?)', (category, dump(value)))
+
+    def export(self):
+        for ident, category, value in self.db.execute(
+                'SELECT id,category,data FROM events WHERE id>? ORDER BY id', (self.export_cursor,)):
+            self.handles[category].write(value + '\n')
+            self.export_cursor = ident
+        for handle in self.handles.values():
+            handle.flush()
+
+    def normalize(self, row):
+        p = row.get('payload', {})
+        timestamp = row.get('timestamp', now())
+        if row.get('type') == 'event_msg' and p.get('type') == 'item_completed':
+            item = p.get('item', {})
+            kind = item.get('type')
+            base = {'timestamp': timestamp, 'turn_id': p.get('turn_id'),
+                    'source': 'codex_item_completed', 'item': item}
+            if kind in ('UserMessage', 'AgentMessage'):
+                content = item.get('content', [])
+                text = '\n'.join(x.get('text', '') for x in content if isinstance(x, dict))
+                self.emit('prompts' if kind == 'UserMessage' else 'responses',
+                          {**base, 'text': text, 'phase': item.get('phase')})
+            elif kind == 'CommandExecution':
+                self.emit('commands', {**base, 'command': item.get('command'),
+                    'cwd': item.get('cwd'), 'exit_code': item.get('exit_code'),
+                    'status': item.get('status'), 'output': item.get('aggregated_output'),
+                    'started_at_ms': p.get('started_at_ms'), 'completed_at_ms': p.get('completed_at_ms')})
+            elif kind == 'FileChange':
+                self.emit('files', {**base, 'actor': 'codex', 'status': item.get('status')})
+            elif kind not in ('Reasoning',):
+                self.emit('tools', base)
+        elif row.get('type') == 'response_item' and p.get('type') in (
+                'function_call', 'custom_tool_call', 'function_call_output', 'custom_tool_call_output'):
+            self.emit('tools', {'timestamp': timestamp, 'source': 'codex_response_item', 'item': p})
+
+    def read_transcript(self):
+        if not self.source.exists():
+            archived = Path.home() / '.codex' / 'archived_sessions' / self.source.name
+            if archived.exists():
+                self.source = archived
+            else:
+                raise FileNotFoundError(str(self.source))
+        offset = self.get('source_offset', 0)
+        size = self.source.stat().st_size
+        if size < offset:
+            raise RuntimeError('Transcript shrank; stop and review before replaying')
+        with self.source.open('rb') as source:
+            source.seek(offset)
+            # Bound each batch so a large output cannot starve filesystem event handling.
+            for _ in range(2000):
+                line = source.readline()
+                if not line or not line.endswith(b'\n'):
+                    break
+                row = json.loads(line)
+                self.emit('raw-session', row)
+                self.normalize(row)
+                self.set('source_offset', source.tell())
+
+    def snapshot(self, path):
+        try:
+            s = path.lstat()
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            return None
+        result = {'size': s.st_size, 'mode': stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode),
+                  'mtime_ns': s.st_mtime_ns, 'inode': s.st_ino}
+        if stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode):
+            result.update(kind='symlink', target=os.readlink(path))
+        elif stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode):
+            result['kind'] = 'directory'
+        elif stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode):
+            result['kind'] = 'file'
+            if s.st_size <= self.cfg['snapshot_max_bytes']:
+                # Do not follow a symlink swapped into place between lstat/open.
+                fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
+                with os.fdopen(fd, 'rb') as stream:
+                    if not stat.S_ISREG(os.fstat(stream.fileno()).st_mode):
+                        result['snapshot_skipped'] = 'type_changed'
+                        return result
+                    data = stream.read(self.cfg['snapshot_max_bytes'] + 1)
+                if len(data) <= self.cfg['snapshot_max_bytes']:
+                    digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+                    blob = self.blobs / digest
+                    if not blob.exists():
+                        blob.write_bytes(data)
+                    result.update(sha256=digest, snapshot=str(blob))
+                else:
+                    result['snapshot_skipped'] = 'size_limit'
+            else:
+                result['snapshot_skipped'] = 'size_limit'
+        else:
+            result['kind'] = 'special'
+        return result
+
+    def file_before(self, path):
+        row = self.db.execute('SELECT data FROM files WHERE path=?', (str(path),)).fetchone()
+        return json.loads(row[0]) if row else None
+
+    def observe(self, path, flags=0, event_id=None, baseline=False):
+        path = Path(os.path.abspath(path))
+        if self.excluded(path):
+            return
+        if not any(path == root or path.is_relative_to(root) for root in self.roots):
+            return
+        before = self.file_before(path)
+        after = self.snapshot(path)
+        actions = [name for flag, name in [(0x100,'created'), (0x200,'deleted'),
+                   (0x800,'renamed'), (0x1000,'modified'), (0x400,'metadata_changed'),
+                   (0x4000,'owner_changed'), (0x8000,'xattr_changed')] if flags & flag]
+        observed = ('created' if before is None and after is not None else
+                    'deleted' if before is not None and after is None else
+                    'modified' if before != after else 'event_only')
+        if baseline or flags or before != after:
+            value = {'source': 'filesystem_baseline' if baseline else 'macos_fsevents',
+                     'actor': 'unknown', 'path': str(path), 'event_id': event_id,
+                     'flags': flags, 'actions': actions, 'observed_change': observed,
+                     'before': before, 'after': after}
+            if not baseline and before != after:
+                try:
+                    old = Path(before['snapshot']).read_bytes() if before and 'snapshot' in before else b''
+                    new = Path(after['snapshot']).read_bytes() if after and 'snapshot' in after else b''
+                    complete = all(x is None or 'snapshot' in x for x in (before, after))
+                    if complete and b'\x00' not in old + new:
+                        value['diff'] = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(
+                            old.decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True),
+                            new.decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True),
+                            fromfile=str(path) + ' (before)', tofile=str(path) + ' (after)'))
+                except UnicodeError:
+                    pass
+            self.emit('files', value)
+        if after is None:
+            self.db.execute('DELETE FROM files WHERE path=?', (str(path),))
+        else:
+            self.db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO files VALUES (?,?)', (str(path), dump(after)))
+
+    def reconcile(self, baseline=False):
+        seen = set()
+        for root in self.roots:
+            for parent, directories, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False,
+                    onerror=lambda e: self.emit('collector', {'event':'scan_error', 'error':str(e)})):
+                directories[:] = [name for name in directories if not self.excluded(Path(parent) / name)]
+                for name in directories + files:
+                    path = Path(parent) / name
+                    if self.excluded(path):
+                        continue
+                    seen.add(str(path))
+                    self.observe(path, baseline=baseline)
+        for (path,) in self.db.execute('SELECT path FROM files').fetchall():
+            if self.excluded(path):
+                self.db.execute('DELETE FROM files WHERE path=?', (path,))
+                continue
+            if path not in seen and Path(path) not in self.roots:
+                self.observe(path)
+
+    def heartbeat(self, status='running'):
+        value = {'status': status, 'pid': os.getpid(), 'session_id': self.cfg['session_id'],
+                 'started_at': self.started, 'updated_at': now(),
+                 'source_transcript': str(self.source), 'source_offset': self.get('source_offset', 0),
+                 'source_bytes': self.source.stat().st_size if self.source.exists() else None,
+                 'watch_roots': [str(p) for p in self.roots],
+                 'excluded_paths': [str(p) for p in self.exclusions],
+                 'filesystem_watcher_alive': self.watcher.thread.is_alive(),
+                 'last_error': self.last_error,
+                 'counts': dict(self.db.execute('SELECT category,count(*) FROM events GROUP BY category'))}
+        atomic_json(self.state / 'status.json', value)
+
+    def run(self):
+        self.watcher = FileEvents([str(p) for p in self.roots],
+                                self.get('fsevent_id', 0xffffffffffffffff), self.pending,
+                                self.excluded)
+        self.watcher.start()
+        with self.db:
+            self.reconcile(baseline=not self.get('baseline_complete', False))
+            self.set('baseline_complete', True)
+            self.emit('collector', {'event': 'started', 'pid': os.getpid(), 'watch_roots': self.cfg['watch_roots']})
+        for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT):
+            signal.signal(sig, lambda *_: setattr(self, 'stopping', True))
+        last_heartbeat = 0
+        while not self.stopping:
+            if not self.watcher.thread.is_alive():
+                raise RuntimeError(self.watcher.error or 'FSEvents thread stopped')
+            try:
+                with self.db:
+                    self.read_transcript()
+                self.last_error = None
+            except Exception as exc:
+                self.last_error = repr(exc)
+                with self.db:
+                    self.emit('collector', {'event': 'transcript_error', 'error': self.last_error})
+            with self.db:
+                for _ in range(10000):
+                    try:
+                        path, flags, event_id = self.pending.get_nowait()
+                    except queue.Empty:
+                        break
+                    try:
+                        self.observe(path, flags, event_id)
+                        if flags & (0x01 | 0x02 | 0x04 | 0x20):
+                            self.emit('collector', {'event':'fsevents_rescan', 'path':path, 'flags':flags})
+                            self.reconcile()
+                        self.set('fsevent_id', event_id)
+                    except OSError as exc:
+                        self.emit('collector', {'event':'file_read_error', 'path':path, 'error':str(exc)})
+            self.export()
+            if time.monotonic() - last_heartbeat >= self.cfg['heartbeat_seconds']:
+                self.heartbeat('degraded' if self.last_error else 'running')
+                last_heartbeat = time.monotonic()
+            time.sleep(self.cfg['poll_seconds'])
+        with self.db:
+            self.read_transcript()
+            self.emit('collector', {'event':'stopped'})
+        self.export()
+        self.heartbeat('stopped')
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('--config', default=str(Path(__file__).with_name('config.json')))
+    parser.add_argument('--status', action='store_true')
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    config_path = Path(args.config).resolve()
+    if args.status:
+        cfg = json.loads(config_path.read_text())
+        status = json.loads((Path(cfg.get('state_dir', config_path.parent)) / 'status.json').read_text())
+        try:
+            os.kill(status['pid'], 0)
+            status['process_alive'] = True
+        except ProcessLookupError:
+            status['process_alive'] = False
+        age = (dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) - dt.datetime.fromisoformat(status['updated_at'])).total_seconds()
+        status['heartbeat_age_seconds'] = round(age, 1)
+        print(json.dumps(status, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+        return 0 if status['process_alive'] and age < 15 and status['status'] == 'running' else 1
+    if not json.loads(config_path.read_text()).get('enabled', False):
+        return 0
+    Collector(config_path).run()
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+# 현재 세션 자동 로깅
+
+적용 세션: `01a1c44e-6036-7f30-81ce-3f42ce6fbac7`  
+설정일: 2026-11-10 (한국 시간)
+
+현재 세션의 Codex 원본 기록을 처음부터 수집하고 이후 기록을 0.5초 간격으로 읽는다. 작업 폴더의 파일 생성·수정·삭제·이름 변경은 macOS FSEvents로 수집한다. macOS LaunchAgent가 현재 로그인 환경에서 실행하며, 비정상 종료 후 재실행하고 다음 로그인 때도 같은 세션의 기록을 이어 간다. 별도 채팅은 자동 수집하지 않는다.
+
+## 저장 위치
+
+- 실제 설정: `/Users/***/Develop/workspace/member-service/session-logging/config.json`
+- 수집기: 같은 폴더의 `logger.py`
+- 실행 상태: 같은 폴더의 `.state/status.json`
+- 로그: 같은 폴더의 `logs/`
+- 로그인 실행 설정 원본: 같은 폴더의 `launch-agent.plist`
+- macOS에 등록한 로그인 실행 설정: `/Users/***/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.local.codex-session-audit.01a1c44e-6036-7f30-81ce-3f42ce6fbac7.plist`
+
+| 파일 | 내용 |
+| --- | --- |
+| `prompts.jsonl` | 사용자가 입력한 프롬프트, 시간, 턴 ID |
+| `responses.jsonl` | 화면에 보이는 AI 중간 응답과 최종 응답 |
+| `commands.jsonl` | 실행 명령, 작업 폴더, 종료 코드, 소요 시간, Codex에 기록된 출력 |
+| `tools.jsonl` | 명령 외 도구 호출 및 결과, 코드 실행 입력 |
+| `files.jsonl` | 생성·수정·삭제·이름 변경 이벤트, 전후 상태, 지원되는 텍스트 diff |

# member-service

Kotlin 기반 Spring Boot 회원 서비스의 초기 프로젝트입니다.

## 개발 환경

| 항목 | 버전 |
| --- | --- |
| JDK | 25 |
| Kotlin | 2.4.21 |
| Spring Boot | 4.1.2 |
| Gradle Wrapper | 9.7.0 |

JDK 25가 필요합니다. Gradle은 포함된 Wrapper로 실행하므로 별도로 설치하지 않아도 됩니다. Java toolchain을 25로 지정했으며, Kotlin 플러그인의 공식 Gradle 지원 범위에 맞춰 버전을 고정했습니다.

기본 패키지는 `com.example.memberservice`입니다. Spring MVC, Bean Validation, Actuator를 포함합니다. 데이터베이스 연결과 회원 API는 후속 작업에서 추가합니다.

## 빌드와 테스트

```sh
./gradlew clean build
```

테스트 보고서는 `build/reports/tests/test/index.html`에 생성됩니다.

## 실행

```sh
./gradlew bootRun
```

기본 포트는 8080이며, 상태 확인 주소는 `http://localhost:8080/actuator/health`입니다.

빌드한 실행 파일로 시작할 수도 있습니다.

```sh
java -jar build/libs/member-service-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar
```

## 세션 로깅

이 작업의 프롬프트·응답·명령·파일 변경 기록은 `session-logging/logs/`에 저장됩니다. 설정과 사용법은 [세션 로깅 안내](session-logging/README.md)를 참고하세요. 로그와 실행 상태 파일은 Git에서 제외됩니다.

## 버전 호환 근거

- [Spring Boot 시스템 요구사항](https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/system-requirements.html)
- [Kotlin Gradle 플러그인 호환표](https://kotlinlang.org/docs/gradle-configure-project.html)
- [Gradle Java 호환표](https://docs.gradle.org/current/userguide/compatibility.html)

+package com.api.member.logging
+
+import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain
+import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest
+import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse
+import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
+import org.slf4j.MDC
+import org.springframework.core.Ordered
+import org.springframework.core.annotation.Order
+import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
+import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter
+import org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerMapping
+import java.util.UUID
+import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
+
+@Component
+@Order(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 10)
+class RequestLoggingFilter : OncePerRequestFilter() {
+
+    private val log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(javaClass)
+    private val validRequestId = Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}")
+
+    override fun doFilterInternal(
+        request: HttpServletRequest,
+        response: HttpServletResponse,
+        filterChain: FilterChain,
+    ) {
+        val previousRequestId = MDC.get("requestId")
+        val requestId = request.getHeader("X-Request-Id")
+            ?.takeIf(validRequestId::matches) ?: UUID.randomUUID().toString()
+        MDC.put("requestId", requestId)
+        response.setHeader("X-Request-Id", requestId)
+        val started = System.nanoTime()
+        var failure: Exception? = null
+        try {
+            filterChain.doFilter(request, response)
+        } catch (exception: Exception) {
+            failure = exception
+            throw exception
+        } finally {
+            try {
+                val status = if (failure != null && response.status < 400) 500 else response.status
+                val durationMs = TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toMillis(System.nanoTime() - started)
+                val path = request.getAttribute(HandlerMapping.BEST_MATCHING_PATTERN_ATTRIBUTE)
+                    ?.toString() ?: request.requestURI
+                val event = when {
+                    status >= 500 -> log.atError()
+                    status >= 400 -> log.atWarn()
+                    else -> log.atInfo()
+                }
+                event.addKeyValue("httpMethod", request.method)
+                    .addKeyValue("requestPath", path)
+                    .addKeyValue("status", status)
+                    .addKeyValue("durationMs", durationMs)
+                    .setCause(failure)
+                    .log("HTTP {} {} -> {} ({} ms)", request.method, path, status, durationMs)
+            } finally {
+                if (previousRequestId == null) MDC.remove("requestId")
+                else MDC.put("requestId", previousRequestId)
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+package com.api.member.logging
+
+import ch.qos.logback.classic.Logger
+import ch.qos.logback.classic.spi.ILoggingEvent
+import ch.qos.logback.core.read.ListAppender
+import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
+import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
+import org.slf4j.MDC
+import org.springframework.mock.web.MockHttpServletRequest
+import org.springframework.mock.web.MockHttpServletResponse
+import org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerMapping
+
+class RequestLoggingFilterTests {
+
+    @Test
+    fun `failed requests log 500 without query or body and restore MDC`() {
+        val logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RequestLoggingFilter::class.java) as Logger
+        val appender = object : ListAppender<ILoggingEvent>() {
+            override fun append(event: ILoggingEvent) {
+                event.prepareForDeferredProcessing()
+                super.append(event)
+            }
+        }
+        appender.start()
+        logger.addAppender(appender)
+        MDC.put("requestId", "prior-context")
+        try {
+            val request = MockHttpServletRequest("GET", "/api/items/42")
+            request.addHeader("X-Request-Id", "failed-request")
+            request.queryString = "token=private-query"
+            request.setContent("private-body".toByteArray())
+            request.setAttribute(HandlerMapping.BEST_MATCHING_PATTERN_ATTRIBUTE, "/api/items/{id}")
+            val response = MockHttpServletResponse()
+            assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
+                RequestLoggingFilter().doFilter(request, response, FilterChain { _, _ ->
+                    throw IllegalStateException("failure")
+                })
+            }
+            val event = appender.list.single()
+            val fields = event.keyValuePairs.associate { it.key to it.value }
+            assertEquals(500, fields["status"])
+            assertEquals("/api/items/{id}", fields["requestPath"])
+            assertEquals("failed-request", event.mdcPropertyMap["requestId"])
+            assertFalse(event.formattedMessage.contains("private-query"))
+            assertFalse(event.formattedMessage.contains("private-body"))
+            assertEquals("prior-context", MDC.get("requestId"))
+        } finally {
+            MDC.clear()
+            logger.detachAppender(appender)
+            appender.stop()
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `request MDC does not leak to the next request`() {
+        MDC.clear()
+        val request = MockHttpServletRequest("GET", "/actuator/health")
+        val response = MockHttpServletResponse()
+        RequestLoggingFilter().doFilter(request, response, FilterChain { _, _ -> })
+        assertNull(MDC.get("requestId"))
+    }
+}

+package com.api.group.logging
+
+import ch.qos.logback.classic.Logger
+import ch.qos.logback.classic.spi.ILoggingEvent
+import ch.qos.logback.core.read.ListAppender
+import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
+import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
+import org.slf4j.MDC
+import org.springframework.mock.web.MockHttpServletRequest
+import org.springframework.mock.web.MockHttpServletResponse
+import org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerMapping
+
+class RequestLoggingFilterTests {
+
+    @Test
+    fun `failed requests log 500 without query or body and restore MDC`() {
+        val logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RequestLoggingFilter::class.java) as Logger
+        val appender = object : ListAppender<ILoggingEvent>() {
+            override fun append(event: ILoggingEvent) {
+                event.prepareForDeferredProcessing()
+                super.append(event)
+            }
+        }
+        appender.start()
+        logger.addAppender(appender)
+        MDC.put("requestId", "prior-context")
+        try {
+            val request = MockHttpServletRequest("GET", "/api/items/42")
+            request.addHeader("X-Request-Id", "failed-request")
+            request.queryString = "token=private-query"
+            request.setContent("private-body".toByteArray())
+            request.setAttribute(HandlerMapping.BEST_MATCHING_PATTERN_ATTRIBUTE, "/api/items/{id}")
+            val response = MockHttpServletResponse()
+            assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
+                RequestLoggingFilter().doFilter(request, response, FilterChain { _, _ ->
+                    throw IllegalStateException("failure")
+                })
+            }
+            val event = appender.list.single()
+            val fields = event.keyValuePairs.associate { it.key to it.value }
+            assertEquals(500, fields["status"])
+            assertEquals("/api/items/{id}", fields["requestPath"])
+            assertEquals("failed-request", event.mdcPropertyMap["requestId"])
+            assertFalse(event.formattedMessage.contains("private-query"))
+            assertFalse(event.formattedMessage.contains("private-body"))
+            assertEquals("prior-context", MDC.get("requestId"))
+        } finally {
+            MDC.clear()
+            logger.detachAppender(appender)
+            appender.stop()
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `request MDC does not leak to the next request`() {
+        MDC.clear()
+        val request = MockHttpServletRequest("GET", "/actuator/health")
+        val response = MockHttpServletResponse()
+        RequestLoggingFilter().doFilter(request, response, FilterChain { _, _ -> })
+        assertNull(MDC.get("requestId"))
+    }
+}

import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from logger import Collector


class TranscriptResumeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_resumed_rollouts_and_legacy_cursor_do_not_replay_items(self):
        state = Path(__file__).parent / '.state'
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=state) as directory:
            home = Path(directory)
            sessions = home / '.codex/sessions/2026/11/10'
            sessions.mkdir(parents=True)
            session_id = 'test-resumed-session'
            first = sessions / f'rollout-01-{session_id}.jsonl'
            second = sessions / f'rollout-02-{session_id}_resumed.jsonl'
            meta = {'type': 'session_meta', 'payload': {'id': session_id}}
            prompt = {'type': 'event_msg', 'payload': {'type': 'item_completed', 'item': {
                'type': 'UserMessage', 'id': 'prompt-1', 'content': [{'text': 'fixture prompt'}]}}}
            response = {'type': 'event_msg', 'payload': {'type': 'item_completed', 'item': {
                'type': 'AgentMessage', 'id': 'reply-1', 'content': [{'text': 'fixture response'}]}}}
            first.write_text('\n'.join(json.dumps(row) for row in [meta, prompt]) + '\n')
            config = home / 'config.json'
            config.write_text(json.dumps({
                'session_id': session_id,
                'source_transcript': str(first),
                'output_dir': str(home / 'logs'),
                'state_dir': str(home / 'state'),
                'watch_roots': [],
            }))
            collector = Collector(config)
            try:
                with patch.object(Path, 'home', return_value=home):
                    with collector.db:
                        collector.read_transcript()
                        # Emulate the cursor written by the previous single-file collector.
                        collector.db.execute("DELETE FROM meta WHERE key='source_offsets'")
                    second.write_text('\n'.join(json.dumps(row) for row in [meta, prompt, response]) + '\n')
                    collector.next_source_discovery = 0
                    with collector.db:
                        collector.read_transcript()
                    counts = dict(collector.db.execute('SELECT category,count(*) FROM events GROUP BY category'))
                    self.assertEqual(5, counts['raw-session'])
                    self.assertEqual(1, counts['prompts'])
                    self.assertEqual(1, counts['responses'])
                    with collector.db:
                        collector.read_transcript()
                    self.assertEqual(counts, dict(collector.db.execute('SELECT category,count(*) FROM events GROUP BY category')))
                    offsets = collector.get('source_offsets')
                    self.assertEqual(first.stat().st_size, offsets[first.name])
                    self.assertEqual(second.stat().st_size, offsets[second.name])
            finally:
                for handle in collector.handles.values():
                    handle.close()
                collector.db.close()
                collector.lock.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

+openapi: 3.1.0
+info:
+  title: Member Service API
+  description: Member 서비스 API 명세
+  version: 1.0.0
+servers:
+- url: /
+  description: 현재 서비스
+tags:
+- name: Actuator
+  description: Monitor and interact
+  externalDocs:
+    description: Spring Boot Actuator Web API Documentation
+    url: https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/docs/current/actuator-api/html/
+paths:
+  /actuator:
+    get:
+      tags:
+      - Actuator
+      summary: Actuator root web endpoint
+      operationId: links
+      responses:
+        "200":
+          description: OK
+          headers:
+            X-Request-Id:
+              description: 요청 추적 ID. 유효한 요청 헤더를 유지하거나 서버가 UUID를 생성합니다.
+              schema:
+                type: string
+          content:
+            application/vnd.spring-boot.actuator.v3+json:
+              schema:
+                type: object
+                additionalProperties:
+                  type: object
+                  additionalProperties:
+                    $ref: "#/components/schemas/Link"
+            application/vnd.spring-boot.actuator.v2+json:
+              schema:
+                type: object
+                additionalProperties:
+                  type: object
+                  additionalProperties:
+                    $ref: "#/components/schemas/Link"
+            application/json:
+              schema:
+                type: object
+                additionalProperties:
+                  type: object
+                  additionalProperties:
+                    $ref: "#/components/schemas/Link"
+  /actuator/health:
+    get:
+      tags:
+      - Actuator
+      summary: Actuator web endpoint 'health'
+      operationId: health
+      responses:
+        "200":
+          description: OK
+          headers:
+            X-Request-Id:
+              description: 요청 추적 ID. 유효한 요청 헤더를 유지하거나 서버가 UUID를 생성합니다.
+              schema:
+                type: string
+          content:
+            application/vnd.spring-boot.actuator.v3+json:
+              schema:
+                type: object
+            application/vnd.spring-boot.actuator.v2+json:
+              schema:
+                type: object
+            application/json:
+              schema:
+                type: object
+components:
+  schemas:
+    Link:
+      type: object
+      properties:
+        href:
+          type: string
+        templated:
+          type: boolean

+## OpenAPI 명세
+
+API 문서는 OpenAPI 3.1.0 규격으로 생성합니다. 문서 버전 `info.version`은 `1.0.0`이며 애플리케이션 빌드 버전과 별도로 관리합니다.
+
+| 서비스 | Swagger UI | JSON 명세 | YAML 명세 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| 멤버 | http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html | http://localhost:8080/v3/api-docs | http://localhost:8080/v3/api-docs.yaml |
+| 그룹 | http://localhost:8081/swagger-ui.html | http://localhost:8081/v3/api-docs | http://localhost:8081/v3/api-docs.yaml |
+
+각 서비스의 `config/OpenApiConfiguration.kt`에서 제목·설명·문서 버전을 설정합니다. 서버 URL은 `/`로 지정해 접속한 서버를 기준으로 API를 호출합니다. 응답의 `X-Request-Id` 헤더도 명세에 포함합니다. 현재 구현된 상태 확인 API를 문서화하며, 이후 추가하는 컨트롤러·요청/응답 DTO도 자동 반영됩니다. 세부 설명과 예시는 `@Operation`, `@Schema` 등으로 보강합니다.
+
+검증 시 생성한 실제 명세 예시:
+
+- [멤버 JSON](docs/examples/member-service.openapi.json) · [멤버 YAML](docs/examples/member-service.openapi.yaml)
+- [그룹 JSON](docs/examples/group-service.openapi.json) · [그룹 YAML](docs/examples/group-service.openapi.yaml)
+
+이 파일들은 검증 시점의 예시입니다. 최신 명세는 실행 중인 서비스의 `/v3/api-docs` 또는 `/v3/api-docs.yaml`에서 확인합니다.
+
+## 애플리케이션 로그
+
+콘솔은 텍스트, 파일은 Spring Boot 기본 Logback을 사용한 ECS JSON Lines 형식입니다. JSON 파일은 로그 한 건마다 한 줄을 기록합니다.
+
+| 출력 | 기본 위치·형식 |
+| --- | --- |
+| 콘솔 | UTC 시간, 레벨, 서비스명, 스레드, 요청 ID, 로거, 메시지 |
+| 멤버 JSON | `logs/member-service.jsonl` |
+| 그룹 JSON | `logs/group-service.jsonl` |
+
+`bootRun`의 작업 디렉터리는 저장소 루트입니다. IDE에서도 작업 디렉터리를 저장소 루트로 지정하면 위 위치에 기록합니다. 실행 위치와 상관없이 경로를 고정하려면 `LOG_DIR` 환경 변수에 절대 경로를 지정합니다.
+
+파일은 10 MB 단위로 압축 회전하고, 보관 기간은 7일, 보관 파일 전체 크기 한도는 100 MB입니다. 로그 디렉터리는 Git에서 제외합니다. 콘솔까지 JSON으로 출력하려면 `LOGGING_STRUCTURED_FORMAT_CONSOLE=ecs`를 지정합니다.
+

+package com.api.group.persistence

+import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.core.ReferenceOption
+import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.core.Table
+import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.core.inList
+import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.javatime.CurrentTimestampWithTimeZone
+import org.jetbrains.exposed.v1.javatime.timestampWithTimeZone
+
+object GroupMembers : Table("\"group_member\"") {
+    val groupId = long("group_id").references(Groups.id, onDelete = ReferenceOption.RESTRICT)
+    // Member IDs belong to the member service; there is no cross-database foreign key.
+    val memberId = long("member_id").uniqueIndex("uq_group_member_member_id")
+    val registeredDate = timestampWithTimeZone("\"registeredDate\"")
+        .defaultExpression(CurrentTimestampWithTimeZone)
+    val permission = enumerationByName<Permission>("permission", 16)
+        .check("ck_group_member_permission") { it inList Permission.entries }
+
+    override val primaryKey = PrimaryKey(groupId, memberId, name = "pk_group_member")
+}

+    private val jdbc = JdbcTemplate(dataSource)

+
+    @Test
+    fun `only the member table exists and Exposed manages transactions`() {
+        assertTrue(transactionManager is SpringTransactionManager)
+        val tables = jdbc.queryForList(

+            String::class.java,

+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `member data round trips and registration time defaults to UTC`() {
+        transactions.executeWithoutResult { transaction ->
+            transaction.setRollbackOnly()
+            val id = Members.insert {
+                it[name] = "테스트 멤버"
+                it[email] = "***"
+                it[address] = "서울특별시"
+            }[Members.id]

+            assertTrue(id > 0)
+            assertEquals("테스트 멤버", member[Members.name])
+            assertEquals("***", member[Members.email])
+            assertEquals("서울특별시", member[Members.address])
+            assertEquals(ZoneOffset.UTC, member[Members.registeredDate].offset)
+        }
+    }

+            }
+        }
+        transactions.executeWithoutResult {
+            assertEquals(0L, Members.selectAll().where { Members.email eq "***" }.count())
+        }
+    }
+}

+    "spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:mem:group-schema-tests;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE",
+    "logging.file.name=build/test-logs/group-database.jsonl",
+])
+class GroupDatabaseTests @Autowired constructor(
+    private val transactionManager: PlatformTransactionManager,
+    dataSource: DataSource,
+) {
+    private val jdbc = JdbcTemplate(dataSource)
+    private val transactions = TransactionTemplate(transactionManager)
+
+    @Test
+    fun `group database contains no member table`() {
+        assertTrue(transactionManager is SpringTransactionManager)
+        val tables = jdbc.queryForList(
+            "SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'PUBLIC' AND TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'",
+            String::class.java,
+        )
+        assertEquals(setOf("group", "group_member"), tables.toSet())
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `one group accepts several members with typed permissions`() = rollback {
+        val groupId = createGroup(Pricing.Advanced)
+        Permission.entries.forEachIndexed { index, permission -> join(groupId, 100L + index, permission) }
+        val memberships = GroupMembers.selectAll().where { GroupMembers.groupId eq groupId }.toList()
+        assertEquals(3, memberships.size)
+        assertEquals(Permission.entries.toSet(), memberships.map { it[GroupMembers.permission] }.toSet())
+        assertTrue(memberships.all { it[GroupMembers.registeredDate].offset == ZoneOffset.UTC })
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `a member cannot join another group or join the same group twice`() = rollback {
+        val first = createGroup(Pricing.Free)
+        val second = createGroup(Pricing.Premiun)
+        join(first, 200L, Permission.Admin)
+        assertThrows(SQLException::class.java) { join(second, 200L, Permission.Viewer) }
+        assertThrows(SQLException::class.java) { join(first, 200L, Permission.Editor) }
+        val membership = GroupMembers.selectAll().where { GroupMembers.memberId eq 200L }.single()
+        assertEquals(first, membership[GroupMembers.groupId])
+        assertEquals(Permission.Admin, membership[GroupMembers.permission])
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `an unknown group is rejected by the foreign key`() = rollback {
+        assertThrows(SQLException::class.java) { join(Long.MAX_VALUE, 300L, Permission.Viewer) }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun `database rejects pricing and permission values outside the supplied enums`() = rollback {
+        val groupId = createGroup(Pricing.Premiun)
+        join(groupId, 400L, Permission.Editor)
+        assertThrows(DataIntegrityViolationException::class.java) {
+            jdbc.update("UPDATE \"group\" SET PRICING = ? WHERE ID = ?", "Premium", groupId)
+        }
+        assertThrows(DataIntegrityViolationException::class.java) {
+            jdbc.update("UPDATE \"group_member\" SET PERMISSION = ? WHERE MEMBER_ID = ?", "Owner", 400L)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun createGroup(pricing: Pricing): Long = Groups.insert {
+        it[name] = "테스트 그룹"
+        it[Groups.pricing] = pricing
+    }[Groups.id]
+
+    private fun join(groupId: Long, memberId: Long, permission: Permission) {
+        GroupMembers.insert {
+            it[GroupMembers.groupId] = groupId
+            it[GroupMembers.memberId] = memberId
+            it[GroupMembers.permission] = permission
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun rollback(block: () -> Unit) {
+        transactions.executeWithoutResult { transaction ->
+            transaction.setRollbackOnly()
+            block()
+        }
+    }
+}

+## H2와 Exposed
+
+각 서버가 별도의 H2 메모리 DB를 사용합니다. Spring Boot 4 전용 `exposed-spring-boot4-starter`를 적용하고, 서버 시작 시 Exposed 테이블 정의에서 스키마를 생성합니다. `@Transactional`은 Exposed의 Spring 트랜잭션 매니저로 처리합니다.
+
+**메모리 DB이므로 서버를 종료하면 데이터가 사라집니다.** 기본 실행에서는 빈 테이블을 만들고, 아래 `sample-data` 프로필로 실행하면 예제 데이터를 추가합니다.
+
+| 서비스 | H2 콘솔 | JDBC URL |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 멤버 | http://localhost:8080/h2-console/ | `jdbc:h2:mem:memberdb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE` |
+| 그룹 | http://localhost:8081/h2-console/ | `jdbc:h2:mem:groupdb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE` |
+
+콘솔 로그인 시 Driver Class는 `org.h2.Driver`, User Name은 `sa`, Password는 빈칸으로 두고, JDBC URL을 위 값으로 바꿉니다. 서버가 실행 중이어야 접속할 수 있습니다. 콘솔은 로컬 개발용이며 외부 접속은 허용하지 않습니다. 비활성화하려면 `SPRING_H2_CONSOLE_ENABLED=false`를 지정합니다.
+
+### 테이블과 관계
+
+멤버 DB에는 `member`만, 그룹 DB에는 `group`과 `group_member`만 생성됩니다.
+
+```mermaid
+flowchart LR
+    subgraph memberDb[멤버 서버 DB]
+        M[member]
+    end
+    subgraph groupDb[그룹 서버 DB]
+        G[group] -->|"1:N · group_id 외래 키"| GM[group_member]
+    end
+    GM -.->|"member_id UNIQUE · 논리 참조"| M
+```
+
+| 테이블 | 컬럼 | 타입·제약 |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `member` | `id` | BIGINT, 자동 증가, PK |
+| | `name` | VARCHAR(100), 필수 |
+| | `email` | VARCHAR(254), 필수 |
+| | `address` | VARCHAR(500), 필수 |
+| | `registeredDate` | TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 생성 시 자동 입력 |
+| `group` | `id` | BIGINT, 자동 증가, PK |
+| | `name` | VARCHAR(100), 필수 |
+| | `registeredDate` | TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 생성 시 자동 입력 |
+| | `pricing` | VARCHAR(16), `Free` / `Advanced` / `Premiun`만 허용 |
+| `group_member` | `group_id` | BIGINT, `group.id`를 참조하는 외래 키 |
+| | `member_id` | BIGINT, UNIQUE |
+| | `registeredDate` | TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 가입 시 자동 입력 |
+| | `permission` | VARCHAR(16), `Viewer` / `Editor` / `Admin`만 허용 |
+
+모든 컬럼은 필수입니다. 생성·가입 시각은 UTC로 저장하고, Kotlin에서는 `OffsetDateTime`을 사용합니다. 날짜 컬럼은 요청한 `registeredDate` 이름을 그대로 유지합니다. 과금 타입도 요청한 `Premiun` 표기를 그대로 사용합니다.
+
+`group_member`의 PK는 `(group_id, member_id)`이며, `member_id` 단독 UNIQUE 제약으로 한 멤버의 중복 가입과 다른 그룹 동시 가입을 막습니다. 가입 행이 없으면 소속 그룹이 없는 멤버가 됩니다. `group_id`는 실제 외래 키로 검증하며, 가입자가 남아 있는 그룹 삭제는 제한합니다.
+
+두 DB가 분리되어 있으므로 `member_id`에는 DB 외래 키를 걸지 않습니다. 멤버 존재 확인·멤버 삭제 시 가입 정보 처리는 이후 서버 간 API 또는 이벤트 연동에서 구현해야 합니다. `pricing`과 `permission`은 Kotlin enum과 DB CHECK 제약 양쪽에서 제한합니다.
+
+테이블 정의는 각 서비스의 `persistence/` 패키지에 있습니다. 그룹의 enum 정의는 `com.api.group.domain`에 있습니다. `group`은 SQL 예약어이므로 직접 조회할 때 아래처럼 테이블명을 큰따옴표로 감쌉니다.
+
+```sql
+-- 멤버 서버 콘솔
+SELECT * FROM "member";
+
+-- 그룹 서버 콘솔
+SELECT * FROM "group";
+SELECT * FROM "group_member";
+
+SELECT gm.MEMBER_ID, g.ID AS GROUP_ID, g."name" AS GROUP_NAME,
+       g.PRICING, gm.PERMISSION, gm."registeredDate"
+FROM "group_member" gm
+JOIN "group" g ON g.ID = gm.GROUP_ID
+ORDER BY gm.MEMBER_ID;
+```
+
+### 샘플 데이터
+
+서로 다른 터미널에서 다음과 같이 실행합니다. IDE에서는 두 서버의 실행 설정에 `SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=sample-data`를 지정하면 됩니다.
+
+```sh
+./gradlew :member-service:bootRun --args='--spring.profiles.active=sample-data'
+./gradlew :group-service:bootRun --args='--spring.profiles.active=sample-data'
+```
+
+새 메모리 DB에 멤버 4명, 그룹 3개, 가입 관계 4개를 만듭니다. 기존 멤버나 그룹 데이터가 있으면 해당 서버의 샘플 생성을 건너뜁니다. 그룹 샘플의 멤버 ID 1~4는 멤버 서버를 함께 `sample-data` 프로필로 새로 시작한 경우에 대응합니다.
+
+| 멤버 ID | 이름 | 이메일 | 주소 | 그룹 ID | 과금 타입 | 권한 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | 김멤버 | *** | 서울특별시 | 1 | Free | Admin |
+| 2 | 이멤버 | *** | 부산광역시 | 1 | Free | Editor |
+| 3 | 박멤버 | *** | 대전광역시 | 2 | Advanced | Viewer |
+| 4 | 최멤버 | *** | 인천광역시 | 3 | Premiun | Admin |
+
+그룹명은 각각 `Free 샘플 그룹`, `Advanced 샘플 그룹`, `Premiun 샘플 그룹`입니다. 위 표는 두 DB의 관계를 설명한 것으로, 멤버 이름·이메일·주소를 그룹 DB에 복제하지 않습니다.
+

+테이블 정의는 각 서비스의 `persistence/` 패키지에 있습니다. 그룹의 enum 정의는 `com.api.group.domain`에 있습니다. `group`은 SQL 예약어이므로 직접 조회할 때 아래처럼 테이블명을 큰따옴표로 감쌉니다.
+
+```sql
+-- 멤버 서버 콘솔
+SELECT * FROM "member";
+
+-- 그룹 서버 콘솔
+SELECT * FROM "group";
+SELECT * FROM "group_member";
+
+SELECT gm.MEMBER_ID, g.ID AS GROUP_ID, g."name" AS GROUP_NAME,
+       g.PRICING, gm.PERMISSION, gm."registeredDate"
+FROM "group_member" gm
+JOIN "group" g ON g.ID = gm.GROUP_ID
+ORDER BY gm.MEMBER_ID;
+```
+
+### 샘플 데이터
+
+서로 다른 터미널에서 다음과 같이 실행합니다. IDE에서는 두 서버의 실행 설정에 `SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=sample-data`를 지정하면 됩니다.
+
+```sh
+./gradlew :member-service:bootRun --args='--spring.profiles.active=sample-data'
+./gradlew :group-service:bootRun --args='--spring.profiles.active=sample-data'
+```
+
+새 메모리 DB에 멤버 4명, 그룹 3개, 가입 관계 4개를 만듭니다. 기존 멤버나 그룹 데이터가 있으면 해당 서버의 샘플 생성을 건너뜁니다. 그룹 샘플의 멤버 ID 1~4는 멤버 서버를 함께 `sample-data` 프로필로 새로 시작한 경우에 대응합니다.

+| 멤버 ID | 이름 | 이메일 | 주소 | 그룹 ID | 과금 타입 | 권한 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

+| 4 | 최멤버 | *** | 인천광역시 | 3 | Premiun | Admin |
+
+그룹명은 각각 `Free 샘플 그룹`, `Advanced 샘플 그룹`, `Premiun 샘플 그룹`입니다. 위 표는 두 DB의 관계를 설명한 것으로, 멤버 이름·이메일·주소를 그룹 DB에 복제하지 않습니다.

+package com.api.member.config
+
+import org.slf4j.MDC
+import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties
+import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.EnableConfigurationProperties
+import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
+import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration
+import org.springframework.http.client.JdkClientHttpRequestFactory
+import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
+import java.net.URI
+import java.net.http.HttpClient
+import java.time.Duration
+
+@ConfigurationProperties("clients.group-service")
+data class GroupServiceProperties(
+    val baseUrl: URI,
+    val connectTimeout: Duration = Duration.ofSeconds(2),
+    val readTimeout: Duration = Duration.ofSeconds(3),
+)
+
+@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
+@EnableConfigurationProperties(GroupServiceProperties::class)
+class GroupServiceClientConfiguration {
+
+    @Bean
+    fun groupServiceRestClient(builder: RestClient.Builder, properties: GroupServiceProperties): RestClient {
+        val httpClient = HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(properties.connectTimeout).build()
+        val requestFactory = JdkClientHttpRequestFactory(httpClient)
+        requestFactory.setReadTimeout(properties.readTimeout)
+        return builder.baseUrl(properties.baseUrl.toString())
+            .requestFactory(requestFactory)
+            .requestInterceptor { request, body, execution ->
+                MDC.get("requestId")?.let { request.headers.set("X-Request-Id", it) }
+                execution.execute(request, body)
+            }
+            .build()
+    }
+}

+package com.api.member.client
+
+import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier
+import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
+import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
+import org.springframework.web.client.RestClientException
+
+data class GroupMembershipsResponse(val memberships: List<GroupMembership>)
+data class GroupMembership(val memberId: String, val group: String, val permission: String)
+
+class GroupServiceException(cause: Throwable? = null) : RuntimeException("그룹 정보를 조회하지 못했습니다.", cause)
+
+@Component
+class GroupMembershipClient(@Qualifier("groupServiceRestClient") private val client: RestClient) {
+
+    fun findByMemberIds(memberIds: List<String>): Map<String, GroupMembership> {
+        if (memberIds.isEmpty()) return emptyMap()
+        val response = try {
+            client.get().uri { uri ->
+                uri.path("/internal/group-members").queryParam("memberIds", memberIds.joinToString(",")).build()
+            }.retrieve().body(GroupMembershipsResponse::class.java)
+                ?: throw GroupServiceException()
+        } catch (exception: RestClientException) {
+            throw GroupServiceException(exception)
+        }
+        val memberships = response.memberships.associateBy { it.memberId }
+        if (memberships.size != response.memberships.size || response.memberships.any {
+                it.memberId !in memberIds || it.group.isBlank() || it.permission !in setOf("Viewer", "Editor", "Admin")
+            }) {
+            throw GroupServiceException()
+        }
+        return memberships
+    }
+}

+    private val members: MemberRepository,
+    private val groups: GroupMembershipClient,
+) {

+        })
+    }
+}

+
+@RestController
+@Tag(name = "Members", description = "멤버 조회")
+class MemberController(private val service: MemberQueryService) {
+
+    @GetMapping("/api/members", produces = [MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE])
+    @Operation(summary = "멤버 목록 조회", description = "멤버 테이블을 먼저 페이징하고 그룹 서비스에서 그룹명·권한을 조회합니다. sort가 없거나 비어 있으면 정렬을 추가하지 않습니다.")
+    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "조회 성공")
+    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "필수 page 누락 또는 잘못된 페이징·정렬 값",
+        content = [Content(mediaType = "application/problem+json", schema = Schema(implementation = ProblemDetail::class))])
+    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "502", description = "그룹 서비스 호출 또는 응답 오류",
+        content = [Content(mediaType = "application/problem+json", schema = Schema(implementation = ProblemDetail::class))])
+    fun findMembers(
+        @Parameter(description = "페이지 번호, 0부터 시작", required = true, example = "0")
+        @RequestParam(name = "page") @Min(0) page: Int,
+        @Parameter(description = "페이지 크기, 기본 20, 최대 100", example = "20")
+        @RequestParam(name = "size", defaultValue = "20") @Min(1) @Max(100) size: Int,
+        @Parameter(description = "이름 정렬. 생략 시 DB 반환 순서", schema = Schema(allowableValues = ["name,asc", "name,desc"]))
+        @RequestParam(name = "sort", required = false) sort: String?,
+    ): MemberListResponse {
+        val order = when {
+            sort.isNullOrBlank() -> null
+            sort == "name,asc" -> MemberNameOrder.ASC
+            sort == "name,desc" -> MemberNameOrder.DESC
+            else -> throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "sort는 name,asc 또는 name,desc만 가능합니다.")
+        }
+        return service.findMembers(page, size, order)
+    }
+}

+package com.api.group.api
+
+import com.api.group.api.dto.GroupMembershipsResponse
+import com.api.group.persistence.GroupMembershipRepository
+import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation
+import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Parameter
+import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag
+import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
+import org.springframework.http.MediaType
+import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping
+import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam
+import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController
+import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException
+
+@RestController
+@Tag(name = "Internal memberships", description = "서버 간 그룹 가입 정보 조회")
+class GroupMembershipController(private val repository: GroupMembershipRepository) {
+    private val validMemberId = Regex("[A-Za-z0-9]{1,32}")
+
+    @GetMapping("/internal/group-members", produces = [MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE])
+    @Operation(summary = "멤버 ID 목록으로 그룹명·권한 일괄 조회", description = "가입 정보가 없는 ID는 응답 목록에서 제외합니다.")
+    fun findMemberships(
+        @Parameter(description = "영문·숫자 ID를 쉼표로 구분, 1~100개", required = true, example = "ax1qwsd12s,bs8as1vfws")
+        @RequestParam(name = "memberIds") memberIds: List<String>,
+    ): GroupMembershipsResponse {
+        if (memberIds.isEmpty() || memberIds.size > 100 || memberIds.any { !validMemberId.matches(it) }) {
+            throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "memberIds는 영문·숫자 1~32자의 ID를 1~100개 지정해야 합니다.")
+        }
+        return GroupMembershipsResponse(repository.findByMemberIds(memberIds.distinct()))
+    }
+}
